mapper.sql: id, kb_scope, kb_id, owner_id, dim, model, content_hash, vec, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_doc_vector(kb_scope, kb_id, owner_id, dim, model, content_hash, vec, update_time) VALUES(#{kbScope}, #{kbId}, #{ownerId}, #{dim}, #{model}, #{contentHash}, #{vec}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE owner_id=VALUES(owner_id), dim=VALUES(dim), model=VALUES(model), content_hash=VALUES(content_hash), vec=VALUES(vec), update_time=NOW()

INSERT INTO kb_doc_vector(kb_scope, kb_id, owner_id, dim, model, content_hash, vec, update_time) VALUES
(#{r.kbScope}, #{r.kbId}, #{r.ownerId}, #{r.dim}, #{r.model}, #{r.contentHash}, #{r.vec}, NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE owner_id=VALUES(owner_id), dim=VALUES(dim), model=VALUES(model), content_hash=VALUES(content_hash), vec=VALUES(vec), update_time=NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM kb_doc_vector WHERE kb_scope=#{kbScope} AND kb_id=#{kbId}
